items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic button
items.description: A button that leans toward the cursor and springs back when it leaves. GSAP quickTo, reduced-motion aware.

items.name: pinned-horizontal-gallery
items.title: Pinned horizontal gallery
items.description: A section that pins while vertical scroll moves its panels sideways. GSAP ScrollTrigger, falls back to a native scroller under reduced motion.

items.name: inertia-carousel
items.title: Inertia carousel
items.description: A carousel you can fling: it glides with the speed of your hand and lands on a slide. GSAP Draggable and InertiaPlugin, with previous and next buttons.
